body:
## Summary

Ready for review following reporter-confirmed automatic USB HDS reconnection
with a real DE1. Coverage and remaining limitations are recorded below.

- Remember serial-less USB HDS as `usb-hds:any`, while retaining attachment IDs
  for transport operations and auxiliary ownership.
- Auto-select only one eligible match after completed serial discovery; multiple
  matches use the existing picker, incomplete discovery retains recovery.
- Normalize native/API selections, reject unsupported temporary scale IDs with
  HTTP 400, and preserve legacy skin highlighting through read-only settings
  projection of a unique matching attachment.

## Linked Issue

Related #1078. The reporter confirmed automatic USB HDS reconnection after a
real DE1 sleep/wake cycle; see Verification. The issue remains open.

## Verification

- Regression tests were written and failed before implementation.
- Focused connection/settings checks passed.
- Full Windows suite (`flutter test --no-pub --concurrency=4`): 6,287 passed,
  19 failed, 3 skipped. All 19 failures also reproduce on unchanged base
  `ab734bb6` in the five affected plugin/credential suites
  (34 passed, 19 failed in that baseline subset); failure-name sets match exactly.
- Flutter analysis reports no issues with the repository-pinned SDK.
- Settings handler has an actual loopback HTTP POST/GET regression check.
- Initial local-lab APK built and signature-verified: `Decaid Test`, package
  `net.tadel.reaprime.localtest`, version `0.9.3-test.1078-preference` (3210).
  No simulated-device defines were supplied. The built snapshot matches all 18
  changed Dart files.
- APK SHA-256: `60cca223f26cb8cd04c40f730da60f1b942546ea070cb0d1d6f8c2253bb56930`.
- Samsung SM-X210 / Android 16 with a real serial-less USB HDS: preference
  survived force-stop/reopen, physical unplug/replug recovered without a manual
  scan (about one minute through retry backoff), and live weight snapshots
  resumed. Android reused the attachment ID;
  changed-ID recovery remains a deterministic-test result.
- One operator-authorized simulated MockDe1 sleep/wake cycle per policy exercised
  both power policies against the real HDS. Disconnect closed the scale
  connection and recovered automatically about 18 seconds after simulated wake;
  displayOff kept it connected and issued display
  sleep/wake commands. Original power mode and simulated state restored.
- No real DE1 or Bengle was operated during the local lab checks. Bengle uses
  its integrated scale as primary and bypasses external-HDS auto-selection, so
  it cannot replace a real DE1 for this test. The local MockDe1 checks do not
  establish physical DE1 sleep/wake, USB suspend, or visible HDS display changes.
  The reporter's real-DE1 verification follows below.

### Real-DE1 Verification (2026-11-17)

- Reviewed the provided `usb hds 2.zip` native and WebView logs.
  The tester used `Decaid Test` `0.9.3-test.1188` (3214), commit `c4f44107`,
  with a real USB-connected DE1XXL and serial-less USB HDS, not MockDe1.
- One `disconnect` policy cycle succeeded (log-local times): DE1 sleep at
  `16:11:53.012`, wake at `16:11:58.307`, automatic USB enumeration at
  `16:12:01.350` (about 3 seconds after wake), and HDS connected at
  `16:12:16.626` (about 18.3 seconds after wake). HDSSerial's connected state
  requires valid weight-frame readiness. No manual scan occurred during wake
  recovery; the completed scan used preferred selector `usb-hds:any`.
- Reporter confirmation: "This time it does reconnect correctly."
- The HDS exposes no USB descriptor serial number; "No USB serial number" is
  the expected preference-row wording, not a lost USB connection. The ZIP
  contains no screenshot, so no screenshot or display appearance was verified.
- Two earlier startup USB probes timed out, and the initial successful HDS
  connection followed a manual scan. This reporter trace therefore does not
  establish startup/restart auto-connect; the separate local-lab restart check
  above remains the evidence for that scenario.
- Final tester APK SHA-256:
  `daac5db47b8330aaef2de390ee98eef4d5d5a4c971b33b72168d84ae369c7ffd`.
  This is the same verified source with PR/commit/version metadata updated;
  no simulated-device or preferred-device build overrides were supplied.

## Impact

- No database migration, new preference key, or dependency.
- Existing exact-device preferences and ephemeral machine identity restrictions
  remain unchanged. Auxiliary reservations remain isolated from primary scale
  selection.
- REST/WS specs and API/device documentation updated. Design rationale archived
  under `doc/plans/archive/1078-serial-less-hds/`.
- Hardware coverage: one real-DE1 Disconnect-policy sleep/wake cycle,
  plus local real-HDS checks described above. Real-DE1 Display Off, visual HDS
  display changes, USB suspend, repeated/overnight cycles, changed attachment
  IDs on hardware, tablet background/foreground recovery, and multiple physical
  HDS attachments remain unverified; they are not claimed as passing tests.
